Source Name: Department of Irrigation — Reservoir Status
Data Type: Daily water levels + available storage for major & medium reservoirs; real-time rainfall at hydromatic stations
Critical Gap Notes: Best real-time water data in LK. Covers large systems only — 14,000+ village tank cascade reservoirs are ABSENT. The most critical Anavaratha pressure reservoir has no monitoring.

Source Name: Mahaweli Authority Statistical Handbook
Data Type: Reservoir storage, hydropower, irrigation extent, cultivation statistics, fishing yields
Critical Gap Notes: Multi-decade series. Good for Mahaweli basin asymmetry analysis. Doesn't capture cascade or minor irrigation systems.

Source Name: National Water Supply & Drainage Board data
Data Type: Drinking water coverage, supply volumes, leakage rates, water quality by district
Critical Gap Notes: Urban/peri-urban focus. Rural & estate water access poorly tracked. Useful for displacement zone analysis (who lacks access).

Source Name: Tank Cascade Research — University of Peradeniya
Provider / Institution: Faculty of Agriculture, Univ. of Peradeniya
Data Type: Academic datasets on cascade hydrology, sedimentation, governance, water quality in minor tanks
Critical Gap Notes: CRITICAL FOR ANAVARATHA. Only systematic cascade research in Sri Lanka. Not a live data portal — must engage researchers directly. Madduma Bandara's foundational 1985 work originates here.

Source Name: CEA Air Resource Management & Monitoring Unit
Data Type: Ambient PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2 — monitoring stations; industrial noise levels
Coverage & Resolution: Very sparse — Colombo (1 station at Fort), Kandy, Battaramulla only
Critical Gap Notes: SEVERE GAP: Colombo has only 1 ground-level station. No monitoring outside 2-3 cities. Island-wide air quality is essentially invisible in official data.

Source Name: IQAir / AQICN Sri Lanka aggregation
Provider / Institution: IQAir / World Air Quality Index Project
Data Type: Aggregated PM2.5/AQI from available stations + satellite-derived estimates
Coverage & Resolution: Sparse ground data; satellite fills gaps approximately
Critical Gap Notes: Best available real-time air data for LK. Honest about sparse station coverage. MV X-Press Pearl 2021 chemical disaster not well-captured in any dataset.

Source Name: Department of Agriculture — Soil Science Division
Data Type: Soil suitability maps, soil series classification, fertiliser recommendations, periodic soil surveys
Coverage & Resolution: National — island-wide soil series mapping; district surveys
Critical Gap Notes: Best domestic soil data. Agronomic focus (fertility for crops). SOC trends, microbiome, erosion rates not tracked. Estate sector (tea/rubber) soil data largely proprietary with plantation companies.

Source Name: Tea Research Institute — Soil & Plant Nutrition
Provider / Institution: Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka (TRI)
Data Type: Soil health in tea-growing regions: pH, organic matter, nutrient status, erosion in Up Country
Coverage & Resolution: Up Country & Mid Country estate zones
Critical Gap Notes: KEY ASYMMETRY SOURCE. Estate soil is the most intensively extracted soil in LK. TRI data reveals decades of nutrient depletion. Connects directly to estate community displacement narrative.

Source Name: Rubber Research Institute — Soil Division
Provider / Institution: Rubber Research Institute of Sri Lanka
Data Type: Soil conditions under rubber monoculture; erosion, compaction, organic matter in wet zone
Coverage & Resolution: Wet zone — Kegalle, Kalutara, Galle districts
Critical Gap Notes: Complements TRI data for wet zone plantation soil. Monoculture impact on soil ecology over decades.

Source Name: National Red List — Sri Lanka (2020/2021)
Data Type: Threatened species assessments: flora (2020), birds (2021), freshwater fish (2020), fauna (2012). Endemic species focus.
Critical Gap Notes: Strongest local biodiversity dataset. Important: Sri Lanka's national red list lists MORE threatened endemic birds (20) than the global IUCN list (8) — local expert knowledge exceeds global aggregation here.

Source Name: Department of Wildlife Conservation — Protected Area Data
Provider / Institution: DWC, Ministry of Wildlife & Forest Conservation
Data Type: Protected area extents, wildlife census data, human-elephant conflict reports, marine turtle nesting
Coverage & Resolution: National; PA network (~13% of land area)
Critical Gap Notes: PA boundary data, annual wildlife counts. Human-elephant conflict a key indicator of habitat pressure and corridor fragmentation in the Anavaratha framework.

Source Name: Forest Department — Forest Cover & Biodiversity
Data Type: Forest cover extent, forest type classification, biodiversity surveys in state forests (~17% of land)
Critical Gap Notes: Sinharaja, Knuckles, Kanneliya data housed here. Wet zone endemic forest — the most biodiverse terrain in the island — is covered. Deforestation alerts not real-time.

Source Name: NARA — National Aquatic Resources Research Agency
Data Type: Marine & freshwater fisheries data, coral reef monitoring, mangrove extent, aquatic biodiversity
Critical Gap Notes: Only systematic marine ecology data for Sri Lanka. Coral bleaching, mangrove loss, lagoon health. Key for coastal displacement zone analysis.

Source Name: IUCN Sri Lanka Country Office — Field Data
Data Type: Species conservation assessments, habitat surveys, community conservation data, wetland monitoring
Critical Gap Notes: Most active on-ground biodiversity monitoring in LK. Six Ramsar sites, four UNESCO biosphere reserves. Good entry point for community-level witnessing methodology.

Source Name: eBird Sri Lanka — Citizen Science Bird Data
Provider / Institution: Cornell Lab of Ornithology / Sri Lanka Bird Community
Data Type: Bird species occurrence records, population trends, range maps, citizen science observations
Critical Gap Notes: Ceylon Bird Club active community. Strong endemic bird data. Useful for sound ecology intersection — bird call monitoring as biophonic health indicator.

Source Name: DWC — Human-Elephant Conflict Database
Data Type: Elephant movement, HEC incidents by location, corridor usage, barrier impacts
Critical Gap Notes: Elephants are the keystone movement ecology indicator in LK. HEC data = direct measure of corridor fragmentation. Connects to tank cascade landscape — ancient elephant corridors overlap with wewa zones.

Source Name: No systematic monitoring exists in Sri Lanka
Data Type: No ambient sound monitoring network exists. No bioacoustic baseline surveys. No national noise mapping equivalent to EU Noise Directive.
Critical Gap Notes: MOST CRITICAL SENSORY GAP. Sinharaja and dry zone village soundscapes — among the most ecologically significant in Asia — are entirely unmonitored. Proxy: eBird bioacoustics data, CEA industrial noise complaints.

Source Name: CEA — Industrial Noise & Vibration Complaints
Data Type: Industrial noise measurement, expressway noise assessment, complaint records
Critical Gap Notes: Regulatory noise data only. Not ecosystem soundscape monitoring. Useful as urban noise pressure indicator for attentional ecology analysis.

Source Name: VIIRS Nighttime Lights — Sri Lanka time series
Data Type: Nighttime light radiance — tracks light pollution expansion, economic activity, post-crisis recovery
Critical Gap Notes: UNIQUE VALUE FOR LK: 2022 economic crisis visible as dramatic dimming of nighttime lights — entropy made visual. Recovery trajectory trackable. Best free satellite proxy for economic-ecological intersection.

Source Name: Copernicus/Sentinel NDVI — Sri Lanka vegetation
Provider / Institution: ESA Copernicus via Google Earth Engine
Data Type: Vegetation greenness, canopy cover, forest/agriculture land use change
Critical Gap Notes: 40-year vegetation history. Wet zone deforestation, dry zone agricultural expansion, post-civil war Northern Province land use change all visible.

Source Name: No systematic monitoring exists in Sri Lanka
Data Type: No VOC monitoring, no odour complaint database, no olfactory ecology data of any kind.
Critical Gap Notes: Same global gap, amplified locally. Proxy approaches: CEA air quality data (VOC components), MV X-Press Pearl 2021 chemical contamination reports, agrochemical use statistics from DOA.

Source Name: HIES — Household Income & Expenditure Survey
Data Type: Household income, expenditure, poverty, time allocation proxies; 25,000 household sample
Critical Gap Notes: Best socioeconomic baseline for LK. Captures estate sector separately — key for visibility gradient analysis. Does NOT capture time use, nature contact, or attentional ecology directly. LankaDatta microdata catalog for academic access.

Source Name: Central Bank of Sri Lanka — Socio-Economic Data
Data Type: GDP, inflation, employment, external debt, trade balance — full economic accounting
Critical Gap Notes: The 'official ledger' in Anavaratha's accounting identity. Reveals what's counted. The gap between CBSL data and total system inputs IS the Anavaratha research question for Sri Lanka.

Source Name: Dialog / Mobitel — Mobile Connectivity Data
Data Type: Mobile penetration, data consumption, connectivity patterns by district
Critical Gap Notes: Proxy for attentional extraction rate. Sri Lanka mobile penetration ~160%. Data consumption = attention consumption. Not open data — annual sustainability reports partially useful.

Source Name: Department of Archaeology — Heritage Sites
Provider / Institution: Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs
Data Type: Archaeological sites, ancient irrigation monuments, temple networks, cultural landscape mapping
Critical Gap Notes: Tank cascade systems registered as archaeological heritage. Provides spatial data on ancient negentropic infrastructure. Cultural memory encoded in temple-tank-village spatial relationships.

Source Name: UNESCO — Sinharaja / Cultural Triangle heritage data
Provider / Institution: UNESCO / Sri Lanka UNESCO National Commission
Data Type: World Heritage Site monitoring, intangible cultural heritage, biosphere reserve conditions
Critical Gap Notes: Sinharaja data feeds into global biodiversity monitoring. Cultural Triangle inscriptions connect ancient hydraulic civilisation to living cultural memory. Key for reservoir monitoring.

Source Name: Indigenous / Estate Community Knowledge — NO DATA
Provider / Institution: GAP — Veddah community, Up Country Tamil estate workers
Data Type: Traditional ecological knowledge, oral histories, ritual agricultural calendars, language vitality of Veddah (Wanniyalaeto) community
Critical Gap Notes: DEEPEST ANAVARATHA GAP IN SRI LANKA. Veddah ecological knowledge = oldest living ecological memory on island. Estate Tamil oral traditions = embodied record of plantation entropy over 200 years. Neither is documented, let alone quantified.

Source Name: Sri Lanka Customs — Trade Statistics
Provider / Institution: Sri Lanka Customs / Department of Commerce
Data Type: Import/export volumes by commodity, virtual material flow data, chemical imports (agrochemicals, plastics)
Critical Gap Notes: Material flow asymmetry data. Agrochemical import volumes = soil entropy input proxy. Plastic imports = waste displacement predictor. Connects to Anavaratha accounting identity left side.

Source Name: Central Bank — External Debt & Current Account
Data Type: External debt stock, current account deficits, foreign reserves — the 2022 collapse precursor data
Critical Gap Notes: THE dataset for understanding the 2022 systemic collapse through Anavaratha's lens. Entropy exploiting temporal delay — visible in decades of current account deficits before crisis. Free, comprehensive, long time series.
